scenes.name: Gótico
scenes.book: Postpunk. Romper todo y empezar de nuevo
scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: Término que Hannett aplicó a Joy Division y luego insulto para los epígonos, hasta que en 1982 los fans lo adoptan como estandarte frente a la excesiva luminosidad del new pop: glamour sepulcral, retorno de lo reprimido, emociones atemporales. Bauhaus («Bela Lugosi's Dead», 1979, el comienzo propiamente dicho; Peter Murphy, sex symbol heredero de Adam Ant y Bowie), The Birthday Party (el gótico americano de Nick Cave: «Release the Bats», Junkyard), Killing Joke («música de tensión», del funk de PiL a Black Sabbath, con un aura inquietante), The Cure (gótico light: Seventeen Seconds, Faith, Pornography). El club The Batcave (1982), el «positive punk», Southern Death Cult, Theatre of Hate, The Sisters of Mercy («¡Nosotros sí somos una banda de rock!»), el death rock de Los Ángeles y Kukl con Björk. Su deriva: coqueteos totalitarios y la conversión en versión postpunk del heavy metal (The Cult).

podcast.title: Founders of The Batcave Club
podcast.body: Members of Specimen founded The Batcave club in Soho, London, in July 1982, which became the central headquarters for the burgeoning goth scene, characterized by its theatrical, performance art-like approach and specific aesthetic. "it was called the Batcave. And it was founded by members of a group called Specimen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Founding The Batcave Club
podcast.body: Speseman, described as a highly ambitious and theatrical group focused on innovative live performances, founded The Batcave nightclub in London in July 1982. "The Batcave was founded by a group called Speseman, a very theatrical group obsessed with pushing the envelope of the live performance."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Radical First Single Release
podcast.body: Specimen's first single was uniquely released on video, a seriously radical move for 1982, demonstrating their theatrical and performance art-like approach to music. "For example, their first single wasn't released on record or cassette. They issued it on video, a seriously radical thing to do for 1982."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Spreading the Goth Gospel
podcast.body: Specimen, through their Batcave club, played a significant role in spreading the goth culture, with Batcave nights franchising to other UK clubs and even to New York, establishing a consistent look, feel, and sound. "The Batcave people did a lot, probably more than anyone, to spread the gospel of Goth in those early days. And again, the heart of it all was specimen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Video-Only Single Release
podcast.body: Their first single was released exclusively on video, not on traditional record or tape, an unusual and "pretty wild" approach for the early 1980s. "For example, their first single wasn't released on record or tape. It was only released on video, which is pretty wild for the early 1980s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Wasp Species
xref.body: In 2012, a single female specimen of a previously unknown type of wasp was captured along a nature trail in Thailand. This unique discovery, so far the only example found, was named *alioti's gaga* after Lady Gaga, and notably, the wasp exhibits a blonde color. "It is now known as alioti's gaga after lady gaga, of course."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
